description:
A fast, resilient, multi-source file retriever and download engine


What's Changed
🚀 Features
- Fear add windows digital ceritficate by @ja7ad in #307
- Feat support manual path for ffmpeg by @m4siha in #310
- Improve gui persist preferences and table controls by @sensifai-team in #313
- Feat embed product version in Windows binaries by @ja7ad in #318
- Feat customizable toolbar with Plugins button by @ja7ad in #324
- Feat open the file on double-click of a finished download by @ja7ad in #327
- Improve one GUI engine worker, coalesce ready reads, skip doomed digest by @ja7ad in #330
- Feat add keyboard range selection to batch download by @m4siha in #335
- Feat prefill notes with the source page of a captured download by @sensifai-team in #343
- Feat cli add --batch-file to hydra interactive by @ja7ad in #344
- Feat add browser plugin action by @ja7ad in #345
- Feat pick Save As folder from recent folders dropdown by @ja7ad in #350
- Feat gui add Downloaded column and Status progress bar by @ja7ad in #365
🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fix honor start-in-tray on macOS login by @ja7ad in #309
- Fix preserve drive roots in browser capture paths by @ja7ad in #312
- Fix keep scheduler queue rows visible by @ja7ad in #315
- Fix show File Info dialog for captured streams by @ja7ad in #316
- Fix run audio extraction with the resolved ffmpeg path by @ja7ad in #321
- Fix avoid macOS abort when closing a window with active text input by @ja7ad in #322
- Fix keep plugin download name when File Info probes the page by @ja7ad in #323
- Fix keep the captured name when a probe only re-escapes it in gui by @EmirMontazeri in #326
- Fix skip official plugin sync in builds without plugins by @ja7ad in #334
- Fix set name_from_browser only when the browser's name is usable by @EmirMontazeri in #333
- Fix appimage bundle libxkbcommon with libxkbcommon-x11 on mixed hosts by @ja7ad in #339
- Fix youtube plugin explain missing JS runtime on n-challenge failure by @ja7ad in #342
- Fix gui redraw at the new size after a Wayland resize by @ja7ad in #347
- Fix let yt-dlp find Node on Windows and enable it by default by @ja7ad in #353
- Fix gui replay the browser User-Agent on captured downloads by @m4siha in #354
- Fix cli keep the TUI queue list within the screen and scroll by @sensifai-team in #359
- Fix cli scroll the interactive queue list with the selection by @ja7ad in #360
- Fix updater keep macOS Full Disk Access across updates by @ja7ad in #362
- Fix updater honour Connection proxy and update portable builds by @ja7ad in #366
- Fix send Chrome's header set to servers that gate on it by @ja7ad in #368
Other Changes
- Feat detect Portable.ini beside the exe for portable mode gui by @ja7ad in #373
New Contributors
- @EmirMontazeri made their first contribution in #326
Full Changelog: v1.1.0...v1.2.0
Windows files are not Authenticode signed.
